lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five semi-vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank; spot size increases and spatial density decreases moving from the anterior (gill-adjacent) to the posterior (mid-body) region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid of approximately 4x5 anchor nodes on the lateral surface posterior to the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank; the primary ridge displays a high vertical intensity gradient with light reflectance on the upper edge and distinct shadow on the lower edge.
